title: Environment
description: The persisted form of a deployment environment (design §7.7): a first-class, governed, reach-scoped resource a workflow version is made available in and whose source credentials form a per-environment set. An environment is governed exactly like a workflow — it carries an administrator set (stored separately) and an audit trail, and creating one grants the creator administration. Backends store this document verbatim.

name.description: The environment's stable name and identity (e.g. production, staging, DEV-MWA-1). Operator-chosen and immutable; credentials and runs key on it.

displayName.description: An optional human-friendly display name; defaults to the name when absent. Mutable.

requireEvidence.description: Whether promotion into this environment requires green publish evidence (workflow-designer design §4.6): when true, a version may be made available here only if its server-attested scenario suite passed at publish. Absent/false preserves the default behaviour — unevidenced versions may be promoted. Mutable.

allowsDraftRuns.description: Development-class flag (workflow-designer design §18): when true, working-copy DRAFTS may execute here as debug runs, under this environment's credential bindings. Absent/false — only published, availability-granted versions run here. Mutable.

requiredIsolation.description: The minimum run isolation this environment requires (ADR 0058). 'Isolated' admits a trigger only where a live runner in this environment advertises an out-of-process backend that hosts the version; 'InProcess' (the default when absent) also allows the in-process collectible-ALC backend. A governed policy an environment administrator sets. Mutable.

runtimeIdentifier.description: The .NET runtime identifier (RID) the serverless native binary is built for when this environment requires 'Isolated' execution (ADR 0055), e.g. 'linux-x64' (the default when absent). Publishing a version here queues a Native-AOT build for this target, and a run is dispatchable only once that build is ready. Ignored for an 'InProcess' environment. Mutable.

checkpointKey.description: The environment's registered checkpoint seal key (ADR 0065): run state written for this environment is sealed to this public key, so any writer (the control plane at run start, the environment's runners per checkpoint) can seal, but only a holder of the tenant-custodied open (private) key — which the platform never sees — can read. Absent on an unsealed environment. Mutable as a pair: registering a new keyId+sealKey is a rotation.

managementTags.description: The security tags (KVP labels) scoping who may MANAGE and SEE this environment (§14.2) — e.g. tenant=acme. Immutable: set at create (the deployment stamps the creator's internal tenant tag), carried forward unchanged on update. Management reads/writes are reach-filtered by these via the caller's AccessContext. Absent on an unscoped environment.

createdBy.description: The actor that created the environment.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The actor that last updated the environment, if any.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the environment was last updated, if ever.

EnvironmentCheckpointKeyInfo.title: EnvironmentCheckpointKeyInfo
EnvironmentCheckpointKeyInfo.description: The environment checkpoint key registration (ADR 0065): the key id sealed envelopes name, and the public seal key.

keyId.description: The identifier the environment's sealed envelopes name (1-255 UTF-8 bytes); rotation registers a new id alongside its new seal key.

sealKey.description: The public seal key: a base64-encoded P-256 SubjectPublicKeyInfo.

SecurityTagInfo.title: SecurityTagInfo
SecurityTagInfo.description: A security label (KVP) scoping the environment for row authorization (§14.2).
